title: Pulmonary rehabilitation delivery choice

citation.title: Pulmonary Rehabilitation for Adults with Chronic Respiratory Disease: An Official American Thoracic Society Clinical Practice Guideline
citation.locator: Question 5: ATS recommendation and implementation considerations

quote: For adults with stable CRD, we recommend offering the choice of center-based PR or telerehabilitation
paraphrase: ATS supports a choice of pulmonary rehabilitation delivery for adults with stable chronic respiratory disease; this is not a finding about this patient.
evidence_limitations: The compared populations were predominantly COPD. Delivery models varied; one remote model was not established as best. Comprehensive assessment and essential rehabilitation components still matter.

questions.question: Does current clinical evidence establish that this patient is an adult with stable chronic respiratory disease within the reference population?
Has an appropriate assessment established the rehabilitation components and supervision this patient needs?
What rehabilitation delivery option does this patient currently prefer, and has participation been discussed with them?
Can the patient use the proposed delivery option given equipment, technology, travel and support needs?
Do the exact patient plan terms, provider participation and buyer capabilities support the proposed service and delivery option?
Has a qualified reviewer checked reference updates, corrections and applicability at this decision date?
